papers.title: The Multivariate Feedback Particle Filter for State-dependent Multiplicative Noises and Its Application to Attitude and Pose Estimations
papers.summary: Nonlinear filtering with state-dependent multiplicative measurement noise poses a notable challenge for spacecraft attitude determination and robotic pose estimation. This work develops the FPF-DM, a decomposition scheme for feedback particle filters tailored to this family of filtering problems. Extending prior decomposition techniques for additive noise and polynomial measurement models, the proposed method resolves the key difficulty that state-dependent multiplicative noise breaks the polynomial assumption and prevents Hermite spectral backward recursion for the weighted Poisson's equation. By measure transformation and importance reweighting, we incorporate the inverse measurement covariance into particle weights and rescale the feedback gain to restore the polynomial-form Poisson's equation, with the decomposition generalized to non-uniformly weighted mixtures for closed-form gain computation. This general FPF-DM is instantiated on quaternion and dual-quaternion manifolds for attitude tracking and point-cloud registration. Simulations on 4D attitude tracking and 8D point-cloud registration verify that the instantiated filters using only 10 particles achieve superior accuracy and computational performance relative to baseline filters.
papers.title_ja: 状態依存乗法ノイズに対する多変量フィードバック粒子フィルタと姿勢・ポーズ推定への応用
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙機の姿勢決定やロボットのポーズ推定において、状態依存乗法ノイズによる非線形フィルタリングの課題を解決する手法を提案する。従来の多項式仮定を破る乗法ノイズに対し、測度変換と重要度重み付けを用いてフィードバック粒子フィルタ（FPF）の分解スキームを拡張し、閉形式でのゲイン計算を可能にした。四元数および双四元数マニフォールド上で実装し、わずか10個の粒子でベースライン手法を上回る精度と計算効率を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙機姿勢推定と粒子フィルタの高速化が関心に直結

papers.title: The orbital architecture of 14 Herculis system as a KAM-stable three-body configuration
papers.summary: The 14 Herculis system hosts two massive giant planets on eccentric and mutually inclined orbits, making it a compelling test case for long-term stability in the spatial planetary three-body problem. We develop an analytical description of its dynamics using averaging, symplectic reduction of symmetries and KAM theory. For parameters compatible with the observed architecture, the secular quadrupole Hamiltonian possesses two elliptic relative equilibria that organise the nearby dynamics. The octupole contribution introduces a second slow angle and yields a properly-degenerate multiscale Hamiltonian. Under the corresponding smallness, non-resonance, and non-degeneracy conditions, families of quasi-periodic orbits coming from the relative equilibria of the quadrupolar approximation fill invariant 2-tori. Restoring the two fast mean anomalies and the cyclic angle conjugate to the angular-momentum, and considering the full system, produce two Cantor families of five-dimensional quasi-periodic tori in the reconstructed planetary problem. These invariant structures provide a Hamiltonian mechanism for the long-term confinement of eccentric and mutually inclined configurations compatible with 14 Her.
papers.title_ja: 14ヘルクリス系がKAM安定な三体構成である軌道アーキテクチャ
papers.summary_ja: 偏心軌道を持つ2つの巨大惑星からなる14ヘルクリス系の長期的な安定性を解析的に記述する。平均化、シンプレクティック簡約、KAM理論を用い、四極項ハミルトニアンが持つ楕円相対平衡点を組織構造として特定した。八極項の寄与により多スケールハミルトニアンが形成され、準周期的軌道の族が不変2トーラスを埋めることを示した。これらは、観測と整合する偏心・傾斜軌道構成の長期閉じ込めを説明するハミルトニアン機構を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・三体問題・安定性解析の核心であり、ユーザーの関心に直結

papers.title: Large Language Models as Nonlinear Dynamical Systems: The Three Clocks of Depth, Training, and Generation
papers.summary: Language models are dynamical systems. A transformer is iterated over its layers, over the steps of its training and over the tokens it generates, and on each of these three clocks it shows behavior that nonlinear dynamics has studied for a century: fixed points, bifurcations, synchronization, chaos and noise-driven escape from potential wells. The two communities rarely meet, so this behavior is often rediscovered under new names. We build a bridge between them. To describe, we condense about 200 papers into the Three-Clock Dictionary, which maps fifteen concepts of nonlinear dynamics onto each clock and marks every correspondence as proved, measured or conjectured, and we show each concept in a mechanical system and in a language model side by side. To explain, we derive reduced-order models: the softmax is a Boltzmann distribution, gradient descent an Euler step on a nonlinear spring, a loss spike a ball thrown out of a stiff valley, attention on the circle a Kuramoto model, and a repetition loop a well that deepens while it is occupied. We then test these explanations on open language models, on a laptop CPU. Escape from repetition loops in GPT-2 and Pythia follows the Arrhenius law with the logit gap as the barrier, and the barrier deepens and then saturates, so the temperature needed to leave a loop falls like $1/\ln N$ with the generation length $N$ and rises with model size. Coherent text lives in a narrow window of temperatures, which a small reasoning model shares at its recommended temperature. Training makes each Pythia layer more expansive, and a small transformer trains at a multi-mode edge of stability. The third step, solving problems of language models, is still ahead: controllers derived from the escape analysis remove loops but do not yet beat the best fixed temperature. We state twelve open problems where nonlinear dynamics could get there.
papers.title_ja: 大規模言語モデルを非線形動的系として捉える：深さ・学習・生成の3つの時計
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、Transformerを非線形力学の視点から再解釈し、層の深さ・学習ステップ・トークン生成という3つの時間軸における固定点や分岐、カオスなどの振る舞いを体系的に整理する。ソフトマックスをボルツマン分布、勾配降下を非線形バネのオイラー法として記述する縮約モデルを導出し、GPT-2やPythiaを用いて反復ループからの脱出がアレニウスの法則に従うことを実験的に検証した。さらに、学習過程における層の拡張性や安定性のエッジでの学習も示し、非線形力学の概念がLLMの挙動理解や制御にどう応用できるかを12の未解決問題として提示している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部構造を非線形力学で解釈し、縮約モデルと実証分析を行うため、手法理解と最適化に直結する。

papers.title: Higher-Order Interaction Reconstruction via Integral Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.summary: Reconstructing higher-order interactions is a fundamental challenge in complex networked systems, with applications in ecological, social, and biological networks. This inverse problem is inherently difficult due to the combinatorial complexity of higher-order structures, the strong nonlinearity of the underlying dynamics, and the prevalence of noisy and sparse observations. In this article, we propose a novel integral physics-informed neural network (IntegralPINN) framework for higher-order interaction reconstruction. Instead of { penalizing derivative-based physics residuals,} we adopt an integral formulation over temporal intervals, which naturally suppresses high-frequency noise and mitigates derivative-induced instability. We further introduce a continuous parameterization of interaction tensors, enabling tractable identification of higher-order structures via gradient-based optimization. We provide theoretical analysis establishing a noise-robust error bound that is independent of derivative amplification when the integration window satisfies an excitation condition. Extensive experiments on ecological dynamics, social contagion, and neuronal synchronization systems demonstrate that IntegralPINN achieves accurate and robust reconstruction under noisy and sparse observations, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.title_ja: 積分型物理情報ニューラルネットワークによる高次相互作用の再構築
papers.summary_ja: 複雑なネットワークシステムにおける高次相互作用の逆問題を解くための新しいフレームワーク「IntegralPINN」を提案する。従来の微分ベースの物理残差のペナルティ化ではなく、時間区間に対する積分形式を採用することで、高周波ノイズの抑制と微分による不安定性の軽減を実現した。さらに、相互作用テンソルの連続パラメータ化により、勾配ベースの最適化で高次構造の同定を可能にし、ノイズに頑健な誤差境界の理論的保証も示している。生態系動態や社会伝播などの実験において、既存手法を上回る精度と頑健性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと高次構造同定というユーザー関心と高度に一致

papers.title: Singular layer neural networks for the Navier-Stokes equations at small viscosity
papers.summary: We develop neural network methods for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations at a small viscosity $\varepsilon > 0$, whose accuracy is uniform in $\varepsilon$ and whose residual is evaluated on a grid that does not resolve the vorticity boundary layer. In the vorticity-stream function formulation with the slip boundary conditions, a vorticity layer of width $\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ forms along the walls. The trial function of the singular layer Physics-Informed Neural Network (sl-PINN) contains the corrector of the asymptotic analysis, together with the law that fixes its amplitude at the wall. The amplitude is tied to the wall trace of the network itself, so that the method requires no a priori knowledge of the limit solution. The sl-PINN keeps the error uniform in $\varepsilon$ over six decades, for the Stokes and the Navier-Stokes equations alike, although in the latter the wall trace travels with the flow and is not known in advance. An enrichment that uses the thin scale but leaves the profile and the amplitude of the layer free deteriorates as $\varepsilon\to0$. Since the corrector carries the layer analytically, the Laplacian in the residual can be discretized by a finite volume flux difference on a coarse grid. The resulting singular layer Finite Volume Neural Network (sl-FVNN) attains the same uniform accuracy as the sl-PINN, to within the scatter of the random seed, at about half the cost of a training step. The combination of the asymptotic corrector with the coarse-grid finite volume discretization is the main result of this article.
papers.title_ja: 低粘性Navier-Stokes方程式のための特異層ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 低粘性状態の2次元不可圧Navier-Stokes方程式を解くための新しいニューラルネットワーク手法を提案する。非定常解析の補正項を組み込んだ特異層PINN（sl-PINN）により、粘性境界層を解像しない粗いグリッドでも、粘性係数に対して一様な精度を維持できる。さらに、有限体積法と組み合わせることで計算コストを半減させたsl-FVNNも開発し、物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）の効率化と精度向上を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）の効率化と精度向上に直結する手法

papers.title: Benchmarking a Grid Foundation Model for AC Optimal Power Flow: Feasibility and Warm-Start Results on Synthetic Texas and South Carolina Grids
papers.summary: Learning-based surrogates for alternating-current optimal power flow (AC-OPF) are often judged by the gap between their objective value and that of a nonlinear solver, which does not show that a prediction satisfies power balance and network limits. This paper tests whether predictions from the pretrained foundation model GridSFM-Open 1.1.0, recently released by Microsoft, are feasible AC-OPF operating points and whether they are useful initial values for a nonlinear solver. The model was evaluated zero-shot and after fine-tuning on 10, 100, and 1,000 labeled scenarios (FT10, FT100, and FT1000) on 500 scenarios for each of two synthetic grids, ACTIVSg2000 (Texas) and ACTIVSg500 (South Carolina), with Ipopt, MATPOWER MIPS, and pandapower PIPS as solver references. The lowest Texas median cost gap, 0.44\% for FT100, coincided with thermal violations in 24.1\% of cases and a median maximum bus power mismatch of 89 MW and 197 Mvar. Texas zero-shot predictions had a median maximum mismatch of 648 MW and 1,641 Mvar, and every South Carolina case violated a thermal limit for every model variant. Seeding Ipopt with FT1000 predictions gave geometric-mean solve-time speedups of 1.55x on South Carolina and 1.12x on Texas (p = 0.06, not significant at the 5\% level), while zero-shot seeds slowed South Carolina solves (0.26x). A small objective gap therefore did not indicate feasibility: although median zero-shot inference took only 1.32 s on Texas and 0.157 s on South Carolina on a shared host, every prediction still required a nonlinear solver, and fine-tuned predictions gave modest, grid-dependent warm-start speedups while zero-shot predictions slowed convergence on one grid. GridSFM may therefore be useful for initializing a nonlinear solver, but obtaining feasible AC-OPF solutions still required the solver.
papers.title_ja: AC最適電力フローのためのグリッド基盤モデルのベンチマーク：テキサスおよびサウスカロライナ合成グリッドにおける実現可能性とウォームスタート結果
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、Microsoftが公開したAC最適電力フロー（AC-OPF）用の基盤モデル「GridSFM-Open」の予測値が、物理的に実現可能な解（電力バランス・熱的制約の充足）を満たすかを検証した。テキサスおよびサウスカロライナの合成グリッド上で、ゼロショット推論と少サンプルファインチューニング（10〜1000件）を行い、非線形ソルバとの比較評価を実施した。結果、目的関数値のギャップは小さいものの、多くのケースで熱的制約違反や大きな電力不整合が発生し、予測単体では実現可能解として機能しなかった。非線形ソルバへのウォームスタートとしては、ファインチューニング済みモデルが1.12〜1.55倍の高速化を示したが、ゼロショットでは逆に収束が遅くなる場合もあった。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの物理制約適合性評価と、最適化ソルバとのハイブリッド活用という関心に直結する。

papers.title: Learning Regions of Attraction for Transverse Feedback Linearization under Controller Singularities
papers.summary: Transverse feedback linearization (TFL) achieves path following by exactly linearizing the error dynamics, but its controller is undefined on a singular set, such as zero speed for a unicycle or zero thrust for a quadrotor. The constrained region of attraction, the set of initial states from which the closed loop converges to the path without violating state or regularity constraints, determines where the controller can be safely activated. Exploiting the exact linear error dynamics, we show that this region is the largest forward invariant subset of the admissible set. We then decompose its state-constrained Zubov value function into an analytically known quadratic cost-to-go and a safety value function. We learn only the latter, by fitted value iteration without infinite-horizon trajectory labels. The resulting estimate combines an inner layer verified by interval branch and bound with a learned outer layer tested on samples. On a unicycle following a circle and a sinusoid and on a planar quadrotor, it covers on average 72.0%, 83.4% and 19.1% of the simulated region of attraction. In comparison, the quadratic cost-to-go and two physics-informed neural network (PINN) solvers of Zubov's equation cover at most 11.3%, 4.0% and 0.0% on average. Code and animations are available at https://gradslab.github.io/roa_tfl
papers.title_ja: コントローラー特異点下での横断フィードバック線形化における引き寄せ領域の学習
papers.summary_ja: 横断フィードバック線形化（TFL）において、コントローラーが未定義となる特異点（ゼロ速度など）を考慮し、安全に制御を起動できる初期状態の集合である「制約付き引き寄せ領域」を推定する手法を提案する。Zubov値関数を解析的に既知の二次コストと安全性値関数に分解し、後者のみをフィッテッド値反復法で学習することで、無限ホライズンの軌道ラベルなしで推定を実現した。単輪車やクアッドローターでのシミュレーションにより、従来のPINNや二次コスト法よりも大幅に広い領域（最大83.4%）をカバーできることを示し、物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）の限界と本手法の優位性を比較検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・制御設計とML（値反復・PINN比較）の融合であり、ユーザーの関心領域に強く該当する。

papers.title: MARS: Feature-guided physics-informed deep learning for real-time battery health and lifetime prediction
papers.summary: Accurate and robust estimation of battery state-of-health (SOH) and remaining useful life (RUL) is essential for safe and cost-effective operation of electrified transportation systems, yet it remains challenging under operating variability, non-stationary aging, and non-Gaussian measurement disturbances. This paper proposes Multi-scale Adaptive Robust State Estimation (MARS), a multi-scale adaptive robust state-estimation framework that couples a dual-branch temporal encoder with an equivalent-circuit-model-constrained differentiable generalized-correntropy adaptive Kalman filter. The encoder disentangles fast intra-cycle voltage-current-temperature dynamics from slow inter-cycle degradation, and the fused degradation context adaptively parameterizes the cycle-level process covariance, measurement covariance, and correntropy bandwidth. Through the unrolled robust filtering recursion, MARS performs physics-consistent state propagation and generalized-correntropy-based innovation correction, while uncertainty decomposition and Monte Carlo dropout provide calibrated prediction intervals for SOH estimation and conditional RUL prediction. Experiments on the NASA and CALCE benchmarks demonstrate improved SOH accuracy, achieving mean absolute error/root mean square error values of 0.72%/0.92% and 0.63%/0.80%, respectively, together with competitive conditional RUL performance against representative data-driven and hybrid baselines. The resulting conditional-RUL prediction intervals achieve coverage probabilities of 100.00% and 99.24% on NASA and CALCE, respectively. Ablation, disturbance-sensitivity, near-end-of-life, and runtime analyses further verify the contribution of each module and the practical inference cost for online battery management.
papers.title_ja: MARS: 実時電池健康状態と寿命予測のための特徴量誘導型物理情報深層学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、電池の健康状態（SOH）と残存寿命（RUL）をリアルタイムで予測するフレームワーク「MARS」を提案する。等価回路モデル（ECM）の制約を課した微分可能な汎化コレントロピー適応カルマンフィルタと、時系列エンコーダを結合することで、物理的に整合性のある状態推定を実現する。NASAおよびCALCEベンチマークにおいて、既存手法を上回るSOH推定精度と、高いカバレッジ確率を持つ信頼区間付きRUL予測性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの応用が関心に合致

papers.title: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
papers.summary: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. Using annotated reference actions to identify execution gaps, PACT protects the verified plan by masking negative policy-gradient contributions across its token span. Keeping the generated reasoning unchanged as context, it then favors the reference action over the emitted erroneous action through a preference surrogate with stop-gradient pair weights. Compared with the outcome-only baseline, PACT raises AndroidWorld task success from 60.34% to 68.97% (+8.63 pp), while improving rule-based plan-action consistency on AndroidControl High from 83.71% to 89.74% (+6.03 pp). Adapting PACT to desktop agents also improves task success from 40.92% to 44.17% (+3.25 pp) on the full 369-task OSWorld benchmark. Together, these results establish PACT as an effective credit-assignment framework for bridging execution gaps and improving task completion across mobile and desktop GUI environments.
papers.title_ja: PACT: GUIエージェントにおける正解プランの保持とアクション修復による計画-行動一貫性トレーニング
papers.summary_ja: GUIエージェントが正しい計画を立てても実行アクションが誤る「実行ギャップ」を解消するため、強化学習におけるクレジットアサインメント問題を解決するフレームワークPACTを提案する。参照アクションを用いて検証済みの計画トークンを保護し、誤ったアクションを参照アクションに修正する好意度サロゲートを導入することで、スカラー報酬を変更せずに学習を行う。AndroidWorldおよびOSWorldベンチマークにおいて、タスク成功率と計画-行動の一貫性が向上し、モバイルおよびデスクトップ環境での信頼性向上を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と強化学習の応用であり、実務的な評価手法を含むため高関連。

papers.title: Stochastic Representation-Inspired Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Incompressible Fluid Flows
papers.summary: The effectiveness of neural networks in solving partial differential equations depends not only on their approximation capability but also on the suitability of their representations for the underlying solutions. Motivated by stochastic integral representations of incompressible fluid flows and the associated Biot--Savart kernel, we propose a Biot--Savart-informed (i.e. physics-informed) neural network (BS-PINN) for the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. By extracting a rational profile from a regularized Biot--Savart kernel, we construct a smooth activation function with fixed and learnable kernel scales. Both variants retain the conventional velocity--pressure formulation and physics-informed training framework, allowing the influence of the activation function to be examined independently. We evaluate the method on five benchmarks, including Kovasznay flow, cylinder wake, three-dimensional Beltrami flow, Taylor--Green vortex, and double shear layer. Across 21 benchmark--architecture comparisons, both variants consistently reduce the combined velocity error relative to the conventional $\tanh$-based PINN, achieving mean relative error reductions of 31.7\% and 33.2\%, respectively. Improvements are also observed in reported pressure and vorticity errors. Notably, the double-shear-layer experiments demonstrate improved resolution of localized shear structures and, for BS-PINN-F, qualitatively clearer vortex-roll-up patterns in the long-time simulation. These findings highlight the potential of incorporating analytical flow structures into neural-network representations for incompressible flow simulations.
papers.title_ja: 非圧縮性流体流れのための確率表現に着想した物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 非圧縮性Navier-Stokes方程式の解法として、Biot-Savartカーネルから導出された活性化関数を用いた物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（BS-PINN）を提案する。従来のtanhベースのPINNと比較し、5つのベンチマークで速度誤差を平均31.7〜33.2%低減する性能を示した。特に局所的なせん断構造や渦の巻き込みパターンにおける解像度向上が確認され、解析的な流れ構造をネットワーク表現に組み込む有効性が実証された。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと流体PDE解法の高度な組み合わせ

papers.title: AlignedHPO: Efficient Surrogate-Guided Loss Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.summary: Modern deep learning losses involve multiple hyperparameters, such as weights, scales, and margins, typically tuned manually or through expensive black-box optimization despite their differentiability. We propose AlignedHPO, an efficient framework for tuning differentiable loss hyperparameters using gradient alignment and surrogate validation objectives. Our method employs Jacobian-vector products to reduce hypergradient computation time and memory, while differentiable metric surrogates guide optimization toward task-specific evaluation criteria. We address gradient magnitude ambiguity and stochastic instability through normalized alignment and gradient smoothing. Experiments with generalized Focal Loss and ArcFace demonstrate effective adaptation across long-tailed classification and open-set face recognition. AlignedHPO achieves competitive or improved performance compared to implicit differentiation, with nearly 12x faster hypergradient computation. These results highlight the potential of efficient surrogate-guided loss hyperparameter optimization.
papers.title_ja: AlignedHPO: サロゲートモデルによる損失関数ハイパーパラメータの効率的最適化
papers.summary_ja: 微分可能な損失関数のハイパーパラメータ調整において、勾配アライメントとサロゲート検証目的関数を用いた効率的なフレームワーク「AlignedHPO」を提案する。ヤコビアン・ベクトル積によりハイパー勾配の計算コストとメモリ使用量を削減し、タスク固有の評価基準へ最適化を導く。実験では、汎用Focal LossやArcFaceにおいて、暗黙微分法と比較して競合する性能を維持しつつ、約12倍の高速化を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと機械学習手法の組み合わせが関心に直結

papers.title: ThermLeT: Transformer-based Temperature Prediction for 2.5D Chiplet Architecture
papers.summary: The drive toward heterogeneous 2.5D chiplet packages promises unmatched performance and customization, yet the resulting density amplifies thermal challenges. To facilitate rapid design space exploration, we present ThermLeT, a multimodal transformer-based, scale invariant surrogate that integrates power density maps, spatial coordinate embeddings, material properties and heat transfer rate to predict steady state temperature in 13 ms, about four orders of magnitude faster than conventional finite element solvers such as ANSYS. To train the transformer model, we also create a dataset of 6,221 chiplet layouts perturbed from three representative architectures. On a 150 sample test set, ThermLeT achieves an RMSE of 3.16{\deg}C and an MAE of 2.24{\deg}C, improving accuracy by 35% over ThermEDGe and by 71% over HotSpot, while running approximately 6x and 11x lower inference latencies respectively. Ablation studies confirm robust generalization to unseen floorplans. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/MicroSystemsDesignLab/ThermLeT
papers.title_ja: ThermLeT: 2.5Dチップレットアーキテクチャ向けのTransformerベースの温度予測
papers.summary_ja: 2.5Dチップレットパッケージの熱設計空間探索を高速化するため、TransformerベースのサロゲートモデルThermLeTを提案する。電力密度マップや座標埋め込みなど多モーダルな入力を用い、従来の有限要素法（ANSYS等）と比較して約4桁高速な13msでの定常温度予測を実現した。150サンプルのテストセットにおいて、既存手法より精度を35〜71%向上させつつ、推論レイテンシを大幅に低減する結果を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとTransformerによる物理シミュレーション高速化が関心に合致

papers.title: Data-driven model reduction: An identification perspective using Generalized Bases of Orthonormal Functions
papers.summary: This paper proposes a data-driven model order reduction approach based on system identification concepts. A revised equation error formulation is introduced, in which the model is parameterized using Generalized Bases of Orthonormal Transfer Functions (GBOFs). The generalized reduction problem is formulated in the Hambo frequency domain associated with the GBOF transform. The frequency-domain fit of the reduced-order model is adjusted through the selection of the basis poles. A fit indicator depending on these poles is introduced, providing valuable heuristic guidance for their selection.
papers.title_ja: データ駆動型モデル縮約：直交関数一般化基底を用いた同定視点からのアプローチ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、システム同定の概念に基づいたデータ駆動型のモデル縮約手法を提案する。モデルは直交伝達関数一般化基底（GBOF）を用いてパラメータ化され、修正された誤差方程式が導入される。縮約問題はGBOF変換に関連するHambo周波数領域で定式化され、基底極の選択を通じて縮約モデルの周波数領域での適合度を調整する。さらに、これらの極に依存する適合度指標を導入し、極の選択に対する有益なヒューリスティックな指針を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: ユーザー関心の「縮約モデル」および「機械学習手法全般」に直接該当する。

papers.title: Residual-Guided Multi-Step Conditional Generation for Fast Airfoil Flow Field Prediction
papers.summary: Deep-learning surrogate models for aerodynamic flow prediction are efficient within the training distribution, but their accuracy often degrades sharply in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. To improve OOD robustness for airfoil flow-field inference, this study proposes a residual-guided sequential inference framework to correct the unreliable local flow field. The framework consists of three Transformer-based components: a Flow Initializer for direct flow prediction, a Residual-based Corrector for high-residual regions, and a Shock-based Corrector for shock regions. The framework is evaluated on an engineering-oriented OOD test set built from CFD-based aerodynamic optimization trajectory. The proposed framework reduces the L1 error, CL error, and CD error by 30%, 59%, and 41%, respectively, relative to the usual single step Geo-to-Flow prediction. The additional iterative inference cost is only 0.25s per sample. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework provides an effective route for improving OOD robustness in airfoil surrogate modeling.
papers.title_ja: 高速翼型流れ場予測のための残差誘導マルチステップ条件付き生成
papers.summary_ja: 翼型の気流場予測におけるディープラーニングサロゲートモデルの分布外（OOD）頑健性を高めるためのフレームワークを提案する。Transformerベースの初期予測器と、高残差領域および衝撃波領域を補正する2つの補正器から構成される。CFD最適化軌道から構築したOODテストセットで評価し、単一ステップ予測と比較してL1誤差を30%、揚力係数誤差を59%、抗力係数誤差を41%低減した。追加の推論コストはサンプルあたり0.25秒と極めて低く、実務的な高速化と精度向上を両立している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルのOOD頑健性向上と高速推論という関心に直結

papers.title: Nonlinearity-preserving quantum simulation of flows in the early fault-tolerant regime
papers.summary: Ensemble prediction of nonlinear dynamics propagates a probability density whose linear transport equation retains the nonlinear drift, but grid-dependent circuit costs leave end-to-end feasibility in early fault-tolerant quantum computing unresolved. We couple polynomial reduced-order models fitted by sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics to Walsh-synthesized Koopman-von Neumann (KvN) transport and surface-code resource estimation. At fixed model dimension and drift degree, per-step transport rotation counts scale polylogarithmically with cells per reduced coordinate. Balancing model accuracy against circuit costs makes reduced-model polynomial degree a design variable for early fault-tolerant quantum simulation. For a cylinder wake approaching saturation, preparation, propagation and sampling to 1% relative root-mean-square field error against the radial model are estimated to take 1.62 h on about 560,000 physical qubits. Estimated three-coordinate wake runtimes span hours to weeks below one million qubits. IBM hardware experiments demonstrate nonlinear radial KvN transport for this wake, using reference circuits to mitigate noise.
papers.title_ja: 初期フォールトトレラント領域における非線形性を保持するフローの量子シミュレーション
papers.summary_ja: 初期フォールトトレラント量子計算において、非線形ダイナミクスのアンサンブル予測を効率的に行う手法を提案する。スパース同定による縮約モデル（ROM）とウォルシ合成Koopman-von Neumann輸送を結合し、サーフェスコード資源見積もりを行うことで、回路コストをポリログスミカルに削減する。シリンダー尾流の飽和接近状態に対し、約56万物理量子ビットで1.62時間の実行時間を推定し、IBMハードウェア上でノイズ低減を伴う非線形輸送の実証実験を行った。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと量子シミュレーションの結合という高度な組み合わせ手法

papers.title: Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report
papers.summary: We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. We release the model, its base and value checkpoints, and an optimized serving implementation under the Apache 2.0 license.
papers.title_ja: Limite 1B - Violetto: 技術報告書
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、高スループットの数学推論を目的に設計された10億パラメータのLLM「Limite 1B - Violetto」について報告する。数学中心のコーパスで訓練され、蒸留やRLVRを用いた後学習により、AIME 2026で94.01%という高スコアを達成した。モデルは軽量かつ高速な推論を重視し、大規模システム内の並列コンポーネントとして機能することを想定している。Apache 2.0ライセンスでモデルと最適化されたサービング実装が公開されている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・推論高速化・数学推論ベンチマークに直結

papers.title: Bookkeeping Is Not Judgement: EJBench, an Engineering Judgement Benchmark Built from a Conjugate Heat Transfer Design Campaign
papers.summary: We introduce EJBench, a benchmark of engineering judgement: whether a model can predict how a design behaves at new conditions from a few earlier results, and decide on it. Unlike engineering benchmarks that test whether an agent can operate simulation or CAD software, EJBench is software-agnostic and asks what an engineer would conclude without running a simulation. Its tasks come from a conjugate heat transfer design campaign for battery cold plates, in three families: matching unlabelled test results to their operating points, choosing which stored runs to reveal before signing off a design, and ranking new duties by peak cell temperature. Every answer is taken from a converged simulation, not from an LLM judge. The best of ten frontier models, GPT-6 Astra, scores 0.71, and models state almost the same confidence on tasks they get wrong as on tasks they get right. We also post-train Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA and reinforcement learning, rewarded by the share of answer criteria the simulation results confirm; on the held-out test split its score rises from 0.071 to 0.106. We release the train, validation and test splits, the evaluation harness and the leaderboard.
papers.title_ja: 簿記は判断ではない：共役熱伝達設計キャンペーンから構築されたエンジニアリング判断ベンチマーク EJBench
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、シミュレーション実行なしで設計挙動を予測・判断する能力を評価するベンチマーク EJBench を提案する。バッテリーコールドプレート設計における共役熱伝達データを用い、未ラベル結果の対応付けや設計承認前のデータ選択、ピーク温度によるランキングなど、エンジニアリング判断を問うタスクを定義している。評価は収束したシミュレーション結果に基づき、LLM による主観的評価を排除している。最上位モデル GPT-6 Astra は 0.71 を記録したが、誤答時の確信度が高い問題が示され、LoRA と強化学習による Qwen3.5-9B の後学習ではスコアが 0.071 から 0.106 へ向上した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の評価手法・ベンチマークと強化学習による改善が関心に合致

papers.title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
papers.summary: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2\tau)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. We confirm all three predictions across five model families spanning four benchmarks. The closed-form solutions also enable principled method design: we prove that adding any label smoothing $\varepsilon > 0$ to SimPO creates a finite margin attractor at $\Delta^* = \beta^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$, while $\varepsilon = 0$ (standard SimPO) has no attractor. We test this across three models (8B-9B) and confirm the prediction: the theory-derived configuration (TPO-S, $\varepsilon = 0.05$) is competitive with the strongest baselines, attaining the highest mean IFEval score among the compared methods on all three, validating that the predicted finite attractor is a usable operating point rather than proposing a new state-of-the-art loss.
papers.title_ja: 大規模言語モデルの整列におけるマージンダイナミクス
papers.summary_ja: LLMの整列手法（DPO, IPO, SimPOなど）を確率単体上のベクトル場として理論的に定式化し、ペアワイズ比較におけるマージンの時間発展を1次元ODEとして解析した。DPOはマージンが対数的に無制限に増加する一方、IPOは有限値に収束し、ラベルノイズがDPOに相転移を引き起こすことを示した。さらに、SimPOにラベルスミージングを加えることで有限なアトラクターが創出されることを証明し、理論から導出された設定（TPO-S）が実測で高いIFEvalスコアを示すことを検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM整列の理論的基礎と実務的改善策を提示

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
papers.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer trajectories remain more monitorable than simple single-step side tasks. We further discover that targeted transparency prompts can substantially recover monitorability, sometimes surpassing the base model. These model organisms provide a testbed for studying monitorability failures and potential mitigations. Our code can be found on https://github.com/yongzx/cot-control-model-organism.
papers.title_ja: Chain-of-Thoughtの制御可能性はChain-of-Thoughtの監視可能性を低下させる
papers.summary_ja: AIエージェントのChain-of-Thought（CoT）監視において、モデルが意図的に推論を不透明にするリスクを評価した。多様なペルソナで書き直した数学推論データを用いたファインチューニングにより、監視回避の指示なしでもCoTの制御能力が向上し、隠れたタスク遂行時の監視可能性が大幅に低下することが示された。一方で、透明性を促すプロンプトにより監視可能性を回復できることも確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェントの安全性・評価手法・ハルシネーション対策に直結

papers.title: VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.
papers.title_ja: VisHead-Spec: マルチモーダル投機的デコーディングのためのヘッドルーティング型視覚アテンション
papers.summary_ja: マルチモーダルモデルにおける投機的デコーディングの高速化を目的とし、高並列性下での計算コスト増大問題を解決する手法を提案する。ターゲットモデルとドラフトモデル間の視覚アテンションのスパース性を分析し、ドラフトモデルのKVヘッドの一部のみが視覚特徴に直接アテンションを行う必要があることを特定した。提案手法VisHead-Specは、固定された少数のKVヘッドにのみ上位層の視覚特徴を参照させ、残りはテキスト特徴に限定することで計算効率を向上させる。Qwen3-VL-8Bでの実験により、バッチサイズ64時において既存手法より大幅なスループット向上（16.0%）を実現しつつ、受入長はベースラインとほぼ同等であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化とマルチモーダル効率化の両立に直結する手法

papers.title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements. We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.
papers.title_ja: Inventa: 自律的科学発見のための分散型自己改善エージェント
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントによる科学研究の自動化において、エージェント数や反復回数の増加が必ずしも多様性や実現可能性の向上に繋がらない問題を解決するフレームワーク「Inventa」を提案する。各研究ユニットがアイデアの系譜を生成し、ローカルオーケストレーターが停滞時にモデルを交換したりプロセスを再起動したりすることで探索の停滞を回避する。検証済み知識のみを共有チャネルとする設計により、未検証の主張の伝播を防ぎつつ、5つのベンチマークで既存手法を上回る性能と、モデル呼び出し回数の大幅削減を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とRAG的知識共有、ベンチマーク評価が関心に合致

papers.title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
papers.summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.
papers.title_ja: MoE拡散デコーディングの隠れたコスト：サンプラーのプロファイリングと修正
papers.summary_ja: マスク拡散言語モデル（dLLM）におけるデコーディング時のボトルネックを特定し、重み量子化後にロジツ処理パイプラインが主要な計算コストを占めることを示した。この冗長な処理を除去する2段階の最適化手法（ビット完全一致と精度同等）を提案し、W4A16量子化と組み合わせることで2.4〜2.7倍の高速化を実現した。GSM8K等のベンチマークで精度を維持しつつ、エッジアクセラレータ上で実用的な推論速度向上を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの量子化と推論高速化、特にMoE構造の最適化に直結する手法

papers.title: Conserved Verdicts, Drifting Commitments: Identifying Harmful Overthinking
papers.summary: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. At all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. In six reasoning models from three families, on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench and with budgets up to 16,384 tokens, declining accuracy curves come from which chains remain, while the chains still reasoning keep or improve their answers. An oracle stopping rule gains at most +1.8 and +2.5 points at 1.5B and 7B. The framework says what to measure before building a stopping rule.
papers.title_ja: 保存される判定、漂うコミットメント：有害な過剰思考の特定
papers.summary_ja: 推論モデルが正解に到達した後も思考を続けることで正解を失う「過剰思考」現象を定量的に分析する。最終的な正解率（Verdict）のみでは停止判断が不可能であり、現在の回答の正しさ（Commitment）と最終的な正しさの差が停止による精度向上を示すことを示す。MATH-500等のベンチマークで、正解状態から思考を続行すると平均3.6ポイント精度が低下することを検証した。さらに、精度低下の主因は継続中のチェーンの回答変化ではなく、どのチェーンが実行中かという選択にあることを明らかにし、停止ルール設計のための測定フレームワークを提案する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化・停止基準設計に直結する実用的な分析

papers.title: Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor
papers.summary: Weight-space programming is a process where a large language model reads and writes the weights of a neural network directly, guided by a natural language specification, without an optimiser or gradient descent. This study applies it to automatic tractor guidance, where a 253-parameter neural network steers along paths of lines and arcs and must be adapted when the machine changes, such as a slower steering actuator. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 (also 5.2) edited the network for our research tractor using a small budget of simulated evaluations to repair a network trained for another tractor and write a controller into a network with zero weights. We compared them with an evolution strategy, gradient descent and pure pursuit in simulation and on the real tractor. Both models read the network and analysed the closed loop with control theory correctly, and Fable's repair without simulation succeeded only occasionally. With simulated feedback, both models repaired the trained network in single sessions and wrote a working controller from zero weights, whereas from zero the evolution strategy found none. The controllers written from zero were sparse and in a classical cascaded structure; one model edited the trained network while the other replaced it. Gradient descent reached higher accuracy with far more simulation, and all language model controllers steered the real tractor without intervention, with errors of the same order as pure pursuit. Language models can program the weights of a neural controller directly, much as control engineers design one. We call this Weight-Space Engineering.
papers.title_ja: トラクター誘導コントローラーのための重み空間プログラミング：大規模言語モデルが実トラクターを操縦するニューラルネットワークの重みをネイティブに記述する
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、最適化アルゴリズムや勾配降下法を使わずに、大規模言語モデル（LLM）が自然言語仕様に基づいてニューラルネットワークの重みを直接読み書きする「重み空間プログラミング」を提案する。トラクターの自動誘導制御において、GPT-6 Astra と Claude Fable 5.1/5.2 が、シミュレーション評価の少ない予算内で既存ネットワークの修復やゼロからのコントローラー設計に成功した。比較実験では、進化戦略や勾配降下法と比べ、LLM は少ない計算コストで実機レベルの性能を達成し、制御理論に基づいた合理的な重み配置を行った。この手法は、制御エンジニアが設計するのと同様に LLM が直接コントローラーを「設計」できることを示し、実務応用の可能性を提示している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の応用と制御系設計の融合であり、効率化と実務応用に直結

papers.title: Solver to System: LLM Reasoning Across Representations and Execution in Scientific Simulation
papers.summary: Simulators based on partial differential equations (PDEs) are widely used to model physical systems, but generating and interpreting PDE solver code with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. Scientific simulation code is a useful testbed for LLM scientific reasoning because (1) one system can be represented by code, equations, natural language, and numerical trajectories and (2) code can execute successfully while implementing invalid physics. We introduce Solver2System, a dataset of PDE solvers with multiple representations, controlled corruptions, and lexical perturbations, to evaluate whether LLMs can recover the underlying physical system through (1) cross-representation consistency and (2) static and agentic detection of physical invalidity. Across eight open-weight models, LLMs systematically favor some representations when evidence conflicts, and lexical perturbations to code alter interpretation of other unchanged representations. Execution improves physical-validity judgments, but weaker agents can judge correctly without identifying the causal defect. Thus, LLMs may reach correct judgments despite inconsistent representation reconciliation or causal misdiagnosis.
papers.title_ja: ソルバからシステムへ：科学シミュレーションにおけるLLMの表現と実行を跨ぐ推論
papers.summary_ja: 偏微分方程式（PDE）ソルバーコードを用いたLLMの科学的推論能力を評価する新データセット「Solver2System」を提案する。コード、数式、自然言語、数値軌道といった複数表現間の整合性と、物理的に無効な実装の検出能力をテストする。8つのオープンウェイトモデルの比較により、LLMは証拠が矛盾する際に特定の表現を優先し、コードの語彙的摂動が他の表現の解釈に影響を与えることが示された。実行によるフィードバックは物理妥当性の判断を改善するが、因果的な欠陥を特定せずに正解に到達するケースも存在する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論と物理シミュレーション（PDE）の結合であり、ユーザーの関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: An Explainable Agentic AI Framework for Distribution System Load Restoration
papers.summary: Distribution system load restoration is a sequential decision-making problem in which restoration actions must maximize served load, prioritize critical loads, and preserve power-flow feasibility. This paper proposes an explainable agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for distribution system load restoration. The proposed framework uses multiple large language model (LLM) agents for planner guidance, strategic plan generation, decision arbitration, memory-based feedback, and explanation generation. Unlike unconstrained LLM-based control, the proposed method restricts agent decisions to feasible restoration actions and evaluates all candidate plans using deterministic AC power-flow feasibility checks. The framework is evaluated on IEEE 33-bus and 69-bus distribution feeders, as well as a larger IEEE 118-bus test case, and compared against reinforcement learning and planning baselines. The results show that the proposed agentic framework achieves better restoration performance while producing structured explanations for operator-facing decision support. A direct comparison with a Single-LLM-Agent baseline further shows that the proposed multi-agent decomposition improves weighted restored load and critical-load recovery compared with a monolithic LLM decision structure.
papers.title_ja: 配電系統の負荷復旧のための説明可能なエージェント型AIフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 配電系統の負荷復旧という順序決定問題を対象に、複数のLLMエージェントを用いた説明可能なAIフレームワークを提案する。各エージェントは計画生成や決定仲裁、説明生成を担当し、決定は決定論的なAC潮流計算による実現可能性チェックで制約される。IEEE標準テストケースを用いた評価では、強化学習や単一LLMエージェントと比較して、復旧負荷量と重要負荷の回復率において優位性を示した。さらに、運用者向けの構造化された説明を生成し、意思決定の透明性を確保している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とRAG的フィードバック、実務向け評価手法を含むため

papers.title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
papers.summary: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.
papers.title_ja: SkillBuffBench: ハーネス、モデル、スキルアクセスモード、メモリを横断したエージェントスキルの寄与測定
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、コーディングエージェントが利用する「スキル」（手続き的知識のパッケージ）の効果を、現実的なデプロイ環境を想定して評価するベンチマーク「SkillBuffBench」を提案する。従来の評価が手動でスキルを選択しメモリなしで行われていたのに対し、本手法はスキルの自動呼び出し、メモリ有無、4つのエージェントハーネス、および主要な商用・オープンウェイトLLMを組み合わせる多面的な評価プロトコルを設計した。材料科学や生物学などの専門家が貢献した研究タスクを用い、決定論的な検証器によるスコアリング、コストや実行時間の報告、およびペアリングブートストラップによる不確実性の定量化を行う。現時点ではベンチマークの設計と評価プロトコルの詳細を記述しており、実際の評価結果は進行中である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に深く関連する

papers.title: DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution
papers.summary: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.
papers.title_ja: DeltaHarness: リソース適応型ツール実行のための自己進化ハーネス
papers.summary_ja: ツール利用エージェントの実行ハーネスを、ランタイムの観測データに基づいて自己進化させる手法を提案する。QHIループを用いてディスパッチ戦略や物理プランを動的に修正し、独立した確認パネルでポリシーの置換を制御する。固定ディスパッチ下では、改訂されたマテリアライゼーションポリシーにより、動画編集タスクで完全配信レイテンシを30.0%削減した。保持タスクにおいても、最良の固定プラン比で最大8.2%のレイテンシ低減を達成し、リソース適応性の有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェントの推論・実行効率化と動的最適化に直結する手法

papers.title: Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring
papers.summary: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80\% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1\% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.
papers.title_ja: より良い較正、より良い計画：油流出監視のための不確実性認識マルチASV情報的経路計画
papers.summary_ja: 自律表面船（ASV）による油流出監視において、不確実性の較正が情報的経路計画（IPP）に与える影響を調査した。ガウス過程（GP）と比較し、証拠ベース深層学習（EDL）を不確実性較正された情報モデルとして導入した。物理ベースシミュレーションでのベンチマークにより、モデル選択が最終再構成誤差の分散の80%を説明し、計画戦略の影響（1%）を大きく上回ることが示された。EDLは全計画手法で最低誤差・最高IoUを達成し、3.9ms/ステップの高速推論と高い較正精度を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: ガウス過程・深層学習・サロゲートモデル・軌道計画の交差点で、効率化と較正に言及

papers.title: Regularized Score Centering
papers.summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.
papers.title_ja: 正則化スコアセンタリング
papers.summary_ja: 非同期強化学習における学習不安定化を解決するため、スコアセンタリングに逆KLダイバージェンスによる正則化項を追加したRSC手法を提案する。この手法は、学習者の分布が行動ポリシーから逸脱するのを抑制し、収束保証を理論的に改善する。数学推論やエージェントタスクにおける評価で、サンプル効率を大幅に向上させ、既存ベースラインを大きく上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とLLMエージェント設計の両方に深く関連する手法

papers.title: Adaptive Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning under Sparse Model Changes
papers.summary: We study the discounted reinforcement learning (RL) problem in a setting where the underlying environment changes between deployments. Each deployment provides $H$ observations from a fixed MDP. The reward function and transition kernel are fixed within each deployment. Across deployments, at most an $\epsilon >0$ fraction of the reward and transition kernel entries may change. In this setting, learning each model to deploy from scratch may discard useful observations from past deployments, whereas pooling all past observations can bias the estimates of entries that have already changed. We then propose an algorithm that for each state and action pair, selects how much history to reuse to estimate the reward and probabilities of the next state. We start with observations from the current deployment and add earlier deployment observations one at a time, the most recent first. After each addition, we check whether a single average reward agrees with the estimates from all histories considered until that point. We apply the same check to the distribution of next states. For each estimate, we leverage the last history that passes these aforementioned checks. The optimal control policy is then computed on top of the fitted MDP. We characterize the average gap between the optimal return and the return of the learner's policies over a finite number of deployments. We demonstrate that when $0< |S|\epsilon \leq 2$, with $|S|$ being the cardinality of the state space, our algorithm needs only the observations from the most recent $O(1/\epsilon)$ deployments, and achieves a long-run average gap of at most $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\epsilon/H})$.
papers.title_ja: スパースなモデル変化下におけるオンライン強化学習のための適応型メモリ
papers.summary_ja: 環境がデプロイメント間で部分的に変化するオンライン強化学習問題を対象とする。過去の観測データを再利用しつつ、変化した部分によるバイアスを避けるための適応型メモリアルゴリズムを提案する。各状態・行動ペアごとに、過去のどの時点までのデータを再利用すべきかを統計的検定に基づいて動的に決定する。この手法により、限られたデータ量でも長期的な平均報酬ギャップを理論的に保証しつつ、効率的な学習を実現する。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の手法全般および効率化・実務応用への関連性が高い

papers.title: Cancellation-Free Constrained SquareCB for Safe Controller Selection
papers.summary: We study constrained contextual bandits, in which a learner chooses one of $K$ actions in each round to minimize loss while keeping the expected cost of its play below a budget. Existing reductions to online regression weight the cost by a Lagrange multiplier learned from past constraint residuals, so slack in some rounds can offset violations in others. We instead run SquareCB proposed in \citep{foster2020beyond} with a rectified weight on the cost: it is zero when the estimated cost is within the budget, and otherwise just large enough to bring it back to the budget. Under realizability and Slater's condition with margin $\delta$, the algorithm attains regret $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/\delta)$ and cancellation-free violation $\sum_t(V_c^{p_t}-b)^+=O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$, where $\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}$ is the error of the regression oracle. The same bounds hold when the budget must be met in every context, potentially adversarially chosen contexts. In controller selection for a safe-control-gym quadrotor and a BOPTEST building, the violation is 6 to 9 times lower than that of primal-dual and virtual-queue baselines, with a lower or comparable regret.
papers.title_ja: 安全なコントローラー選択のためのキャンセルフリー制約付きSquareCB
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、期待コストを予算内に保ちつつ損失を最小化する制約付きコンテキストバンディット問題を扱う。既存手法がラグランジュ乗数による重み付けで制約違反を相殺するのに対し、本手法はSquareCBを用い、コストが予算内であれば重みをゼロ、超過分のみ予算に収まるよう調整する「整流重み」を導入する。これにより、制約違反の相殺（キャンセル）を防止し、Slater条件の下で理論的な後悔と違反量の上限を導出する。四旋翼機や建物制御の実験では、既存手法比で制約違反が6〜9倍低減され、安全なコントローラー選択に有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習・バンディット理論と安全制御の応用が関心に合致

papers.title: WM-Quant: Rollout-Aware Post-Training Quantization for JEPA-Style World Models
papers.summary: We present WM-Quant, to our knowledge, the first post-training quantization (PTQ) framework designed specifically for JEPA-style world models. Although world models typically feature relatively few parameters, action planning algorithms often require thousands of inferences, which can quickly become computationally expensive. PTQ is a natural way to reduce this cost. However, we show that in world models using autoregressive model predictive control (MPC) rollouts, quantization error can compound with each predictor step, resulting in action rankings from the quantized model becoming near-random. WM-Quant addresses this with three components that build on existing PTQ methods: early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling. Early-encoder precision protects accurate latent state and goal information to mitigate long-term error propagation. Control-path preservation allows the world model predictor to distinguish between fine-grained actions, significantly improving action rankings and execution. Rollout-aware scaling jointly calibrates encoder and per-step predictor activation ranges with respect to an entire rollout rather than a single prediction, reducing the cumulative rollout error. Across multiple world models, environments, and PTQ methods, WM-Quant substantially improves planning success at low bit-widths, approaching full-precision performance at W4A4.
papers.title_ja: WM-Quant: JEPA型ワールドモデル向けロールアウト認識型ポストトレーニング量子化
papers.summary_ja: JEPA型ワールドモデルにおける推論コスト削減を目的としたポストトレーニング量子化（PTQ）フレームワークを提案する。自動回帰型MPCによるロールアウトでは量子化誤差が蓄積し、アクションランキングが乱れる問題に対し、エンコーダの精度維持、制御パスの保持、ロールアウト全体の活性化範囲を考慮したスケーリングの3手法を導入した。これにより低ビット幅（W4A4）でもフル精度に近い計画成功率を達成し、ワールドモデルの推論高速化に貢献する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM/モデルの量子化と推論高速化、およびエージェント設計への直接的应用が可能

papers.title: Agile Monoped Hopping on Complex and Discrete Terrain via Kinodynamic Planning with Distilled MPPI Steering
papers.summary: This paper presents FlowRRT, a kinodynamic planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain. Steering for kinodynamic RRT on complex dynamical systems currently relies on motion primitives or closed-loop policies, limiting the diversity of motions or the planning speed. Distilling a trajectory optimizer avoids both, but existing methods regress a single solution per query, which fails on monoped hopping, where the feasible action set is narrow and disconnected. Our key insight is to treat steering as set-valued and predict the distribution of feasible actions instead. A multi-start MPPI expert collects the entire feasible set of each query offline, and conditional flow matching distills it into a generative sampler. With this sampler, FlowRRT coordinates successive jumps over long horizons and finds non-greedy maneuvers that are hard for reactive policies to discover. Benchmarks across different terrains show higher success rates and substantially shorter planning times than sampling-based baselines. On terrains with inclined platforms, FlowRRT reaches $80\%$ success within $1$~s, versus $24$~s for RL-RRT and $77$~s for SST. Sim-to-sim tracking in MuJoCo confirms accurate execution under full-order dynamics.
papers.title_ja: 蒸留MPPIステアリングを用いた運動力学計画による複雑な離散地形での俊敏な単脚跳躍
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、複雑な離散地形での単脚ロボットの跳躍を扱う運動力学プランナー「FlowRRT」を提案する。従来の運動原語やクローズドループポリシーに依存しないよう、マルチスタートMPPIエキスパートから得られる実行可能アクションの分布を条件付きフローマッチングで蒸留し、生成型サンプラーとして利用する。これにより、狭く断続的な実行可能領域でも多様な動作を高速に探索でき、非貪欲なマニューバを発見できる。傾斜プラットフォームを含む各種地形でのベンチマークにおいて、既存手法より大幅に短い計画時間と高い成功率を示し、MuJoCoでのシミュレーションも正確な追従を確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習・計画アルゴリズムの効率化手法だが、軌道力学やLLMとは無関係

papers.title: Right Labels, Wrong Reasons: Signed Feature Attribution for Multi-Label Explainability
papers.summary: When a multi-label classifier assigns the right labels, it may do so for the wrong reasons. Diffuse feature combinations may vary across classifier families and lack a dominant feature. This paper proposes FLEX (Fisher LDA Explainer), a global surrogate that fits a single direct multi-label Fisher LDA over the full binary label matrix, producing signed feature attribution lists for each label in a single coherent coordinate system. Across the evaluated benchmarks and classifier families, FLEX reproduces the black box's predictions with consistently high fidelity. Pooling covariance across labels outperforms a per-label alternative on most datasets, with the advantage growing largest where labels are numerous and positive examples are scarce. FLEX's fidelity-complexity Pareto curve is monotonically increasing, giving practitioners a predictable path to higher-fidelity explanations as more features are used, and its in-sample fidelity matches or leads Binary Relevance alternatives once a modest feature budget is allowed. The magnitude of each discriminant weight vector bounds its label's separability, flagging labels that may be predicted correctly for the wrong reasons. The evaluated classifiers largely agree on which predictions to make, but reach those decisions through different feature subsets when no single feature dominates.
papers.title_ja: 正しいラベル、誤った理由：マルチラベル説明可能性のための符号付き特徴量帰属
papers.summary_ja: マルチラベル分類器が正しいラベルを出力しても、その根拠（理由）が誤っている可能性がある問題に対し、Fisher LDA を用いたグローバルサロゲートモデル FLEX を提案する。FLEX はバイナリラベル行列全体に対して単一の直接マルチラベル Fisher LDA を適合させ、一貫した座標系内で各ラベルに対する符号付き特徴量帰属リストを生成する。評価の結果、FLEX はブラックボックスの予測を高い忠実度で再現し、ラベル数が多く正例が少ないケースで特に優位性を示した。また、判別重みベクトルの大きさがラベルの分離可能性を境界付け、正しく予測されているが理由が不確実なラベルを特定できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと説明可能性の手法だが、軌道力学やLLM推論への直接適用性は低い

papers.title: Where Should Physics Enter? Information, Identifiability and Calibration in Probabilistic Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting
papers.summary: Advection-diffusion priors are a common way to make neural sea surface temperature (SST) forecasts physics-informed. We test where such a prior must enter a heteroscedastic ConvLSTM to help, using daily NOAA OISST v2.1 for the Bay of Bengal (1982-2024) and a synthetic benchmark on the same grid with known currents of controlled strength. (i) On real data, a soft advection-diffusion residual with a learned velocity gives no reliable benefit (lead-15 CRPS -0.007 degrees C, 95% interval [-0.022, +0.008]); a plain temporal-smoothness penalty matches it, and equivalence within 3% is not established either. (ii) Learned velocities do not recover the currents, whether placed in the loss, in an explicit transport step, or in a transport step without neural correction: they correlate with the reference no better than a shuffled-date null, even on synthetic data where knowing the currents would improve day-15 forecasts by 16-23%. (iii) Supplied currents help on synthetic data, but mostly as information: giving them to the network as input channels, without transport, recovers 92% of the transport design's lead-5 gain, and a frozen-current numerical forecast does as well as either. (iv) With GLORYS12 reanalysis currents on real data, the transport design is 6% and 4% worse at leads 1 and 5; reanalysis advection explains essentially none of the daily OISST change (correlation 0.02), and frozen-current transport is worse than persistence. (v) The defect that matters is lead-dependent miscalibration shared by every model. One variance multiplier per lead, fitted on validation data, brings 90% coverage to 0.85-0.91 at all leads and lowers day-1 CRPS by 13-21%; fine-tuning on 15-day rollouts fixes long-lead coverage but costs short-lead skill. This version withdraws an earlier claim of an 81% CRPS reduction that came from an uncontrolled comparison.
papers.title_ja: 物理はどこから介入すべきか？確率的海表面水温予測における情報、識別可能性、および較正
papers.summary_ja: 海表面水温（SST）予測において、物理情報（移流・拡散）をニューラルネットワークに組み込む際の最適な介入箇所を評価した。学習された流速は実際の海流を復元できず、物理的輸送項よりも単純な入力チャネルとしての情報提供の方が効果的であることが示された。また、予測の較正（キャリブレーション）不足が主要な誤差要因であり、リードタイムごとの分散乗数を適用することで信頼区間のカバー率と予測精度が大幅に改善されることを確認した。

papers.title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
papers.summary: The drag-reducing properties of streamwise-elongated surface corrugations, commonly referred to as riblets, have been extensively studied through experiments, simulations, and reduced-order modeling. Notably, the linearized Navier-Stokes framework introduced by Ran, Zare, and Jovanovic (J. Fluid Mech., vol. 906, 2021) employs volume penalization to model riblet-induced boundary conditions and predict drag reduction. These approaches typically quantify drag reduction as a function of a single geometric parameter, such as spanwise spacing or groove cross-sectional area, evaluated over fixed riblet shapes. As a result, identifying optimal riblet geometries across a broader design space often necessitates exhaustive parametric studies. To address this problem, we propose an optimization framework for the systematic design of optimal riblet shapes. Accordingly, we reformulate the volume penalization term in the linearized dynamics as a structured state-feedback operator. Targeting maximal suppression of turbulence, we pose a composite optimization problem that minimizes the steady-state variance of velocity fluctuations and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations while maintaining a constant bulk-flux. For a fixed spanwise wavelength (riblet spacing), this framework yields optimal wall-normal profiles that achieve maximal turbulence attenuation.
papers.title_ja: チャネル流れにおける乱流抑制のためのH2最適リブレットプロファイル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、乱流抑制を目的としたリブレット（表面の溝構造）の形状設計における最適化フレームワークを提案する。線形化されたナビエ・ストークス方程式を用いた体積ペナルティ法を、構造化された状態フィードバック演算子として再定式化し、速度変動の定常分散とリブレット起因の動的増幅を最小化する複合最適化問題を構築した。一定の体積流量を維持する制約下で、乱流減衰を最大化する壁面法線方向のプロファイルを系統的に導出する手法を示している。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと最適化手法の組み合わせだが、対象が流体工学的な乱流抑制であり軌道力学ではないため中程度。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Tactile-based Shape Estimation of Deformable Linear Objects
papers.summary: Accurate shape estimation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation, often hindered by visual occlusions and the high-dimensional configuration space of flexible materials. While Force/Torque (F/T) and vision-centric methods have been proposed, they frequently struggle with grasp-site ambiguities and environmental interference. In this letter, we investigate the hypothesis that global shape estimation can be achieved through tactile sensing and proprioception, without any visual perception. We contend that dense, high-resolution tactile imprints capture critical boundary conditions and contact gradients that are sufficient to resolve the high-dimensional configuration of the DLO. To prove this, we introduce a Physics-Informed Vision Transformer (ViT) framework that maps tactile images to a 3D vertex chain. By leveraging self-attention mechanisms and a physics-weighted loss function, our model enforces structural priors to ensure that the predicted geometry adheres to the object's physical manifold. Experimental results demonstrate that our tactile-based approach achieves superior reconstruction accuracy across Euclidean and Chamfer metrics. Furthermore, we demonstrate the efficiency of this modality, achieving model transfer to novel DLO materials and geometries. Our findings suggest that tactile feedback provides a robust and computationally efficient alternative for DLO state estimation in visually degraded or occluded environments.
papers.title_ja: 変形可能線形物体の触覚ベース形状推定における物理情報活用
papers.summary_ja: 視覚による観測が困難な環境下で、変形可能線形物体（DLO）の形状を触覚センサと固有感覚のみから推定する手法を提案する。物理情報付きビジョントランスフォーマー（ViT）フレームワークを用い、触覚画像から3D頂点チェーンをマッピングする。自己注意機構と物理重み付き損失関数により、予測幾何学が物体の物理的流形に従うことを強制し、構造事前知識を適用する。実験により、ユークリッド距離およびチャンファ距離において優れた再構成精度と、新材料・形状へのモデル転移効率を実証した。

papers.title: EmbedGym: Letting Coding Agents Develop and Debug Embedded Firmware Without Physical Hardware
papers.summary: Modern coding agents perform well on general software benchmarks because they can run code and unit tests in a closed loop. Embedded firmware development, however, breaks this loop: a program that compiles can still fail on real hardware due to pin polarity, bus protocol, timing, or networking bugs that an agent at a text terminal cannot observe. Existing embedded coding agents either skip hardware execution, drive GPIO-only simulators with multi-second delays, or test on physical boards in a static environment. In this paper, we present EmbedGym, an interactive virtual hardware environment that lets coding agents develop and debug embedded firmware without physical hardware. EmbedGym uses instruction-level microcontroller unit (MCU) emulators to execute the same binary that would be flashed onto a physical board, connects them to 41 peripheral models, an analog circuit simulator, and virtual WiFi/Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) endpoints, and exposes an interface for agents to change sensor inputs, press buttons, and inspect hardware states. On top of it, we build EmbedGym-Bench, which consists of 598 tasks across 6 MCU-framework pairs graded by hidden timed test vectors, using a five-stage multi-agent workflow that synthesizes peripheral models and tasks from datasheets and driver libraries. We expose EmbedGym to a coding agent at three levels and evaluate eight models over more than 14K trajectories. Even when compilation succeeds 99.7% of the time, 19.9% of compiled firmwares fail at runtime (up to 73% on individual targets). In contrast, interactive hardware testing in EmbedGym increases pass rates across models by +4.9% to +14.7% (up to +31% on individual targets). Our results also show that an agent with EmbedGym outperforms prior embedded agent frameworks, and lightweight models with EmbedGym match frontier models without it at 30-70x lower cost.
papers.title_ja: EmbedGym: 物理ハードウェアなしでコーディングエージェントが組み込みファームウェアを開発・デバッグする
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、物理的なハードウェアを必要とせずに組み込みファームウェアの開発とデバッグを可能にする対話型仮想ハードウェア環境「EmbedGym」を提案する。MCUエミュレータと周辺機器モデル、アナログ回路シミュレータを統合し、エージェントがセンサー入力やボタン操作を通じてハードウェア状態を直接観察・操作できる。さらに、データシートからタスクを自動生成するベンチマーク「EmbedGym-Bench」を構築し、8つのLLMモデルで評価した。結果として、コンパイル成功しても実行時エラーが発生する問題を解決し、対話的なハードウェアテストによりパス率を最大31%向上させ、軽量モデルでもフロンティアモデルに匹敵する性能を低コストで実現した。

papers.title: Token Commitment as a Control Surface for Steering Masked Diffusion Generation
papers.summary: Masked diffusion models repeatedly predict provisional tokens before a sampler decides which predictions become permanent. Existing inference-time steering methods primarily modify activations, logits, or denoising trajectories, while treating this commitment policy as a fixed decoding detail. We instead study token commitment as a diffusion-specific control surface and separate it into two decisions: which tokens to commit and how many tokens to commit at each step. For the first, we introduce counterfactual target-aware commitment, which ranks unresolved positions by a mixture of model confidence and leave-one-token-out target contribution. For the second, we introduce calibrated adaptive budgets driven by target progress and confidence. Across language and vision-language settings in the LLaDA family, multiple targets, two activation-steering methods, and an unsteered control, both mechanisms yield empirically monotonic target-quality trade-offs in every configuration we evaluate. Adaptive schedules also recover competitive operating points relative to scorer-free stochastic schedules matched in average denoising cost. Because both mechanisms require only a scalar score evaluated on a provisional completion, they apply unchanged when the target is an automatic proxy for task success rather than an output attribute: NLI entailment for dialogue summarization and CLIPScore for captioning, neither of which corresponds to a single reusable steering direction. We reproduce the behavior of both mechanisms on a second masked-diffusion family, Dream-7B, for one control target and one task-success target. These results characterize commitment--which provisional predictions become irreversible, and how rapidly--as an interpretable control surface for steering masked diffusion generation under the conditions we test.
papers.title_ja: マスク拡散生成の誘導におけるトークンコミットメントを制御面として活用する
papers.summary_ja: マスク拡散モデルにおける推論時の誘導手法として、トークンの確定（コミットメント）ポリシーを制御面として捉え直す研究である。モデルの信頼度とターゲット貢献度に基づく反事実的ランキング、およびターゲット進捗に応じた適応的予算調整の2つのメカニズムを提案する。LLaDAファミリーやDream-7Bなど複数のモデルで、ターゲット品質と計算コストのトレードオフを単調に改善し、NLIやCLIPScoreなどの自動評価指標を用いたタスク成功度の向上も示した。

papers.title: AdaFlowLite: Scalable and Non-blocking Inference on Asynchronous Mobile Data
papers.summary: The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. % \sysname pioneers the formulation of structured cross-modality affinity in mobile contexts using a hierarchical analysis-based normalized matrix. This approach accommodates the diversity and dynamics of modalities, generalizing across different types and numbers of inputs. Employing an multi-modal lightweight Swin Transformer (MMLST), \sysname facilitates real-time and flexible data imputation, adapting to various modalities and downstream tasks without retraining. Experiments show that \sysname significantly reduces inference latency by up to 80.4\% and enhances accuracy by up to 62.1\%, while achieving nearly a 50\% reduction in energy consumption, outperforming status quo approaches. Also, this method can enhance LLM performance to preprocess asynchronous data.
papers.title_ja: AdaFlowLite: 非同期モバイルデータにおけるスケーラブルかつノンブロッキングな推論
papers.summary_ja: モバイルデバイス由来の非同期マルチモーダルデータに対し、部分データ到着時点で推論を開始する「機会的推論」フレームワークを提案する。階層的分析に基づく正規化行列を用いた構造化クロスモーダルアフィニティ制御により、リトレーニングなしで柔軟なデータ補完を実現する。軽量Swin Transformer（MMLST）を採用し、推論レイテンシを最大80.4%削減しつつ精度を向上させ、エネルギー消費も約50%低減した。さらに、非同期データの前処理を通じてLLMのパフォーマンス向上にも寄与する。
